scoring.boundary: Volume and efficiency describe performance, not isolation, difficult-shot making, or transferable talent by themselves.

creation.boundary: Assist output does not establish advantage creation, decision speed, or passing reads; use tracking/actual observations when available.

off_ball.boundary: Assisted made-shot share is NOT the share of all attempts, gravity, cutting quality, or catch-and-shoot efficiency.

defense.boundary: Only event/context description. Individual screen navigation, positioning, effort and matchup ability require observation or stronger data.

tactical_fit.boundary: State enabling conditions and conflicts. Pace/assist rate do not prove a named offensive system or causal fit.

shot_context.coverage: FGA/FGM/3PA/3PM exactly match base; appearance GP may include zero-FGA games.
